note: Compatibility research for Lilo. 'verified: true' means the page in 'source' stated the facts on the compile date; everything else is UNVERIFIED. liloWifi: true = tested working, "untested (pedxml capability-detected)" = machine looks compatible but Lilo has not been run against it, false = no Wi-Fi path with Lilo. No machine has been tested with Lilo on real hardware yet (Brother NV2700 test pending). Brand and product names belong to their owners; Lilo is not affiliated.

formats.name: Brother PES
formats.note: Brother and Baby Lock native. Stores thread colours.

formats.name: Brother PEC
formats.note: The stitch block inside a PES, also used alone by older Brother machines.

formats.name: Tajima DST
formats.note: The commercial standard. Colour changes are kept as stops, thread colours are not.

formats.name: Melco EXP
formats.note: No thread colours. Bernina machines read it when ART is not available.

formats.name: Janome JEF
formats.note: Janome native. Newer machines also accept JEF+ and JPX, which Lilo does not read or write (see JEF+ below).

formats.name: Janome JEF+ / JPX
formats.note: Newer Janome files (MB-7, MC550E, MC9850) in a JEF-like container with a different header flag. Janome has not published the layout, pyembroidery only reads JPX stitches and drops the colours, and no sample files or maker docs were found, so Lilo does not guess at it. Use JEF.

formats.name: Pfaff / Husqvarna Viking VP3
formats.note: Current Pfaff and Viking format.

formats.name: Singer XXX
formats.note: Singer native.

formats.name: Barudan U01
formats.note: Needle numbers, not thread colours.

formats.name: Husqvarna HUS
formats.note: Older Viking format (VP3 replaced it). Colours become the nearest of Husqvarna's 29 thread colours. Written with the format's own compression wrapper around the raw data, which any reader accepts but is bigger than a real compressor would make it. Checked against pyembroidery's reader; not yet tried on a machine.

formats.name: Husqvarna SHV
formats.note: Older Viking format. Low priority.

formats.name: Janome / Elna SEW
formats.note: Older Janome/Elna format. Low priority.

formats.name: Brother PHC
formats.note: Brother file with a thumbnail. Machines that take PHC also take PES, which Lilo writes.

formats.name: Brother PHX
formats.note: As PHC. Not needed while PES works.

formats.name: Bernina ART
formats.note: Proprietary object format (outlines and settings, not stitches). Not practical to write. Use EXP for Bernina.

formats.name: Elna EMD
formats.note: Elna native. Closed; no maker docs found.

formats.name: Barudan DSB
formats.note: Older Barudan format. DST or U01 cover it.

formats.name: Barudan / Sunstar DAT
formats.note: Older Barudan and Sunstar format.

formats.name: Tajima TBF
formats.note: Tajima's colour-aware format. Written byte for byte as pyembroidery writes it. Colours are matched to colour blocks in order, and needles are numbered 1 to 5 round and round. Not yet tried on a machine; DST also covers the machine.

formats.name: Happy TAP
formats.note: Happy's own format. DST covers the machine.

formats.name: Toyota 100 / 10o
formats.note: Toyota native. DST covers the machine.

formats.name: ZSK ZXY / DSZ
formats.note: ZSK's own formats. DST covers the machine.

formats.name: Husqvarna / Pfaff VIP
formats.note: Pfaff and Viking format with exact RGB colours. Written to the layout in Jason Weiler's notes and libembroidery; the short record before the stitch data is taken from libembroidery's unfinished writer, and no independent reader (pyembroidery has none) or real VIP file was available to check it, so it is checked only by Lilo's own round trip. Treat it as untested on machines.

formats.name: G-code
formats.note: Not a machine format: a stitch path for CNC, plotter and DIY tools, written as pyembroidery writes it (G00 moves, M00 pause at each colour change, M30 end). Write only: there is nothing to open.
